name: Microsoft Learn
short_description: Microsoft's free learning platform with modules and learning paths on Microsoft products; its content can be turned on as a source in Viva Learning.

evidence.quote: This includes Microsoft learn content, Microsoft 365 training
In the Viva learning admin tab, turn on Microsoft Learn. It's free and instant.
W zakładce administratora Viva Learning włącz Microsoft Learn.
На вкладці адміністратора Viva Learning увімкніть Microsoft Learn.
It was not about learning what you learn in Microsoft learn.
Ciò include i contenuti di Microsoft Learn, la formazione su Microsoft 365
Isso inclui conteúdo do Microsoft Learn, treinamento Microsoft 365
Esto incluye contenido en Microsoft Learn, capacitación de Microsoft 365 y academias especializadas
